design: Freeze before first forward pass or measuring these results. Compare the unchanged examiner critic on its natural orientation, its physical 180 degree rotation (no seat swap), and their arithmetic mean. No weight fitting; no V2 maps, formal maps or new matches. Records pre-exist and earlier studies exposed outcomes.
source: Frozen Master3s2 SHA256 65f268b2919ce30fe19355115a928eada032a6beaa018d801662d434c083f2b5. Use only the eight traces/two seats per map under val in opponent_policy/protocol.json, then score the separate seven completed original examiner seats in dev1/hosted; report absent 582 derivative seat1 / original seat0 (bilateral startup timeout, no actions). Exclude 590/591. Retain every registered source and selected root; no ranking or fitting.
input: t=7+13k, k=0..22 (23 roots per game). Follow the original examiner's own legal public history and its actual past commands. Encode its estimated carbon, current and previous players, then native rounding and five original scalars. Primary includes the native search evaluator's constant known=1 mask on the belief-estimated map. Secondary diagnostic repeats on the actual tracker known mask as at the actor's root. No true full carbon, future or same-step commands enter any forward. Rotate exactly by spatial 180 and exchange up/down,left/right on directional input planes; five perspective-preserving global scalars unchanged. Test rotation twice gives the initial tensor. For the computation use the untouched original _net or bitwise-equivalent native weights, no value clipping/calibration.
outcome: Actual official score by seat at the recorded trajectory's natural terminal. Target = native _terminal(original examiner score minus other score), i.e. clip(margin/3000,-2.5,2.5) + 0.5 sign(margin). Expose official scores and saturation. Also report _terminal(current visible cash margin) as a simple independent reference. This is observational calibration along one actual continuation, not a choice between counterfactual successors.
metrics: Primary equal-map mean squared raw prediction error for leaf-contract known=1. Within map average per-game means (seats that actually played), then across the four maps; report change avg versus old, RMSE, MAE, signed bias, per-map change, and count of improved maps. Secondary original- or rotated-view-only and cash reference, thirds by step 0..99,100..199,200..298, actual known mask, by-seat direction. Expose strongest improved and harmed roots and all paired raw results. A favorable observational result requires lower primary mean squared error in both domains and at least 3/4 better maps in each. It cannot promote a search policy. Equal rules under rotation do not imply equal EV under orientation-biased players or guards.
cost: one CPU, at most 345 selected positions and two mask conventions, 1380 critic state encodings; no new original matches.
